---
name: Gameplay / learning feature
about: A feature that a child will play. Every section is required.
labels: feature
---

## Learning objective

Which objective (e.g. `add-within-20`, 1.OA.C.6) does the child practise?

## Player behaviour

What does the child physically do? (tap, drag, choose, build…)

## Success feedback

What changes in the world when they succeed?

## Failure / hint behaviour

How does the game teach rather than punish? What do hint levels 1 and 2 show?

## Accessibility

- [ ] Operable by keyboard, pointer and touch
- [ ] Spoken/text equivalent for anything shown only on the canvas
- [ ] Works with Calm motion (no movement-only information)
- [ ] No information by colour alone; no flashing > 3×/second

## Data

What, if anything, is persisted or transmitted? (Default answer: nothing new.
Anything else needs the `coppa-data-minimization` skill review.)
